recognize_zh: 這是 blast gate 的 HLA-DR 對 CD38 流式圖：綠色異常芽細胞群 HLA-DR 陽性、CD38 陰性至弱陽性，與上方紅色 CD38 較亮的正常前驅細胞區隔；BPDCN 芽細胞常呈 HLA-DR 陽性並伴隨 CD38 表現偏弱。
features: Dot plot: HLADR-PB (x-axis) versus CD38-APC750 (y-axis), gated on blasts
Abnormal population (green) HLA-DR-positive at moderate intensity
Residual normal progenitors (red) HLA-DR-positive with brighter CD38, positioned above the green cluster
Scattered red CD38-variable/HLA-DR-negative events and rare blue lymphoid events
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of HLA-DR versus CD38 gated on blasts shows the abnormal population (green) to be HLA-DR-positive with negative to dim CD38. Residual normal progenitors (red) co-express HLA-DR with brighter CD38 and sit above the abnormal cluster, providing internal contrast. HLA-DR positivity is expected in blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, and decreased CD38 relative to normal progenitors is an aberrant feature supporting a neoplastic population. Interpretation requires integration with CD4, CD56, bright CD123 and absent lineage markers.

ddx.vs: AML blasts are often HLA-DR+ with variable CD38 but express CD34/CD117 and CD13/CD33, which this population lacks on companion plots.
APL blasts are characteristically HLA-DR-negative with high side scatter and bright CD33, the opposite of this HLA-DR-positive population.
